abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of combat attacks made by friendly non-**^^Hero Infantry^^** units while they are wholly within 9" of a friendly **Krethusa**.

abilities.name: Plumes of Auspicious Smoke
abilities.effect:
Friendly **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood** units are either **empty** or **full**. They start the battle **empty**.
While a friendly  **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood** unit is **full**:
• That  **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood** has **^^Ward (4+)^^** against damage points inflicted by shooting attacks.
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly **^^Croneseer's Pariahs^^** units while they are wholly within 9" of that  **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood**.

abilities.name: Laden with Prophecy
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **empty**  **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood**.
abilities.effect: If any enemy models were slain this turn by that  **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood**'s combat attacks, it becomes **full**.

abilities.name: The Blood Reveals All
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Croneseer's Pariahs Hero^^** within the combat range of a friendly empty  **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood**. Then, pick another unit within the combat range of that **^^Hero^^** to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Allocate a number of damage points to the target equal to the roll (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). Then, that  **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood** becomes **full**.

abilities.name: Skilled Skirmishers
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Croneseer's Pariahs Cavalry^^** unit that has not charged this turn and is in combat with an enemy unit that charged this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On 3+, the target can immediately use a **^^Retreat^^** ability as if it were your movement phase. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the target by that **^^Retreat^^** ability.

abilities.name: Blade of Prophetic Doom
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 2+:
• If the target is not damaged, inflict 1 mortal damage on it.
• If the target is damaged, inflict an amount of mortal damage on it equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Proselyte of Morai-Heg
abilities.effect: Enemy units cannot use commands while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Wings of the Crone Goddess
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Croneseer's Pariahs Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Croneseer's Pariahs^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• The target has **^^Fly^^**.
• Add 2" to the target's Move characteristic. If the chanting roll was 8+, add 6" to the target's Move characteristic instead.

abilities.name: Auspicious Strike
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Croneseer's Pariahs Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Croneseer's Pariahs^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the unmodified hit roll for an attack made against the target is 1, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the Fight ability has been resolved. If the chanting roll was 10+, inflict 1 mortal damage foreach unmodified hit roll of 1-2 instead.

abilities.name: Augury of Battle
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Croneseer's Pariahs Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Croneseer's Pariahs^^** unit wholly within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target has **^^Ward (5+)^^**. If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick up to 2 friendly **^^Croneseer's Pariahs^^** units wholly within 18" of the caster instead of 1.

abilities.name: Surge of Hatred
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick either a friendly **Shadow Queen** wholly within 12" of this unit and in combat or a visible friendly non-**^^Hero Daughters of Khaine^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit and in combat to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: If the target is a friendly **Shadow Queen**, it can immediately use a **^^Fight^^** ability as if it were your combat phase. Otherwise, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with the target.

abilities.name: The Iron Heart of Khaine
abilities.effect:
Each time you perform a blood rite, immediately after the ability that destroyed a unit has been resolved, pick 1 of the following effects:
• Until the start of your next turn, this unit is only visible to enemy units while those units are within its combat range.
• **Heal (D6)** this unit or a friendly **Shadow Queen**.
• A friendly **Shadow Queen** can immediately use the 'Normal Move' or 'Retreat' ability as if it was your movement phase even if it has already used that ability or another **^^Core^^** ability this phase.
**Designer's Note:** *If the Shadow Queen retreats with the 'Iron Heart of Khaine' ability, she cannot subsequently use the 'Fight' ability in the same combat phase.*
• Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
• For the rest of the turn, set this unit's Control characteristic to 5 and a friendly **Shadow Queen**'s Control characteristic to 15.

abilities.name: Divine Matriarch
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine Priest^^** or **^^Wizard^^** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls and chanting rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Aura of Agony
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• Enemy **^^Manifestations^^** cannot be set up within 12" of this unit.
• This unit has **^^Ward (4+)^^** against mortal damage inflicted by **^^Spell^^** abilities, **^^Prayer^^** abilities and abilities used by **^^Manifestations^^**.

abilities.name: Born of Slaughter
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: If there are fewer friendly **Avatars of Khaine** on the battlefield than there are friendly **Bloodwrack Shrines** on the battlefield, make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up an **Avatar of Khaine** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Agonising Spasms
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^Shoot^^** ability for this unit
abilities.effect: After that **^^Shoot^^** ability has been resolved, if all of this unit's attacks made as part of that **^^Shoot^^** ability targeted the same enemy unit and any enemy models were slain by those attacks, roll a dice. On a 3+, that enemy unit has a maximum control score of 1 for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Ironscale's Fury
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine^^** unit within this unit's combat range to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the phase, each time a model in a target unit is slain by a combat attack, roll a dice. If that unit is a **Blood Sisters** or **Blood Stalkers** unit, roll 2 dice instead. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit.

abilities.name: Exsanguinating Glare
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is in combat, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. If this unit is not in combat, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, if any enemy models were slain by that mortal damage, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to its Health characteristic.

abilities.name: Arcane Resonance
abilities.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit when it uses a **^^Summon^^** ability and add 1 to banishment rolls for this unit.

abilities.name: Heartseekers
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **^^Shoot^^** ability for this unit
abilities.effect: After that **^^Shoot^^** ability has been resolved, if all of this unit's attacks targeted the same enemy unit, roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if any other friendly **Blood Stalkers** units picked that enemy unit to be the target of all of their shooting attacks this turn. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

abilities.name: Crystal Touch
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Infantry^^** or **^^Cavalry^^** unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or less than the target's Health characteristic, the target has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Fire and Flight
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **^^Shoot^^** ability for this unit
abilities.effect: After that **^^Shoot^^** ability has been resolved, this unit can move 2D6". It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: Fight and Flight
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move 12". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat. Then, roll a D3 for each enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: In Dark Communion
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine^^** **^^Wizard^^** or **^^Priest^^** within 3" of this terrain feature to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target is in dark communion until this terrain feature uses this ability again or until this terrain feature is removed from the battlefield, whichever comes first. While the target is in dark communion, you can re-roll 1 casting roll or 1 chanting roll for the target each turn.

abilities.name: Call to Murder
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
Pick a blessing from the 'Blessings of Khaine' ability that is active. That blessing is no longer active. Then, pick a blessing that is not active. That blessing is now active.


Designer's Note: When you use this ability, you are not using the 'Blessings of Khaine' ability.

abilities.name: Frenzied Slaughter
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^Daughters of Khaine^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If this unit is in combat, you can re-roll the dice. If the roll is lower than your **fury level**, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons used by this unit and the target until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Dark Majesty
abilities.effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack made by a non-**^^Hero^^** unit that targets the friendly **Morathi-Khaine** is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

abilities.name: The Blood Saints
abilities.effect: While the friendly **Shadow Queen** is wholly within 6" of a friendly non-**^^Hero Zainthar Kai^^** unit, both that **Shadow Queen** and that non-**^^Hero^^** unit have **^^Ward (5+)^^**.

abilities.name: Matriarch of the Zainthar Kai
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick the friendly **Morathi-Khaine** to use this ability.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
• Until the start of your next turn, this unit has a Move characteristic of 12" and has **^^Fly^^**.
• This unit can use the 'Iron Heart of Khaine' ability as if you had performed a blood rite.
• Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target. For the rest of the turn, the target's attacks cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).
• Pick a friendly non-**^^Unique Zainthar Kai Hero^^** that has been destroyed to be the target. Set up a replacement unit identical to the target within 3" of this unit.

abilities.name: Explosive Fury
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
abilities.declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with any non-**^^Unique Zainthar Kai^^** units to be the targets,
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.

abilities.name: Ethereal Grace
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Zainthar Kai Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Zainthar Kai^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Add 2" to the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: On Wings of Shadow
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Zainthar Kai Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Zainthar Kai^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Speed of the Scáthborn
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Zainthar Kai Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Zainthar Kai^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: The target has **^^Strike-first^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Khaine's Inheritor
abilities.timing: Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Halve the target's Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Manifestations of Murder
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare:
Pick a friendly **^^Zainthar Kai Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly **^^Manifestations^^** below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
• **Bloodwrack Viper**
• **Bladewind**
• **Heart of Fury**
abilities.effect: If you picked a **Bloodwrack Viper** or **Bladewind**, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you picked a **Heart of Fury**, set it up wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Amulet of the Bladed Queen
abilities.effect: This unit has **^^Ward (5+)^^**. Add 1 to save rolls for this unit.

weapons.name: Staff of Tzeentch and Blazing Sword

abilities.name: Armour-bane Curse
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for combat attacks that target that unit until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: With Spell and Sword
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can use a non-**^^Summon Spell^^** ability as if it were your hero phase, as if that ability had the **^^Unlimited^^** keyword and as if this unit had not cast any spells this turn.

abilities.name: Silver Monoliths
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit while it is wholly within 12" of a friendly **Argent Shard**.

abilities.name: Idolarc
abilities.effect: This unit's **Idolarc** is a token. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place its **Idolarc** next to it.

abilities.name: Chosen by the Stone
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit has any models carrying an **Antithete Bow**, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, place the **Idolarcs** of all other friendly **Jade Obelisk** units next to their respective units. Then, place this unit's **Idolarc** next to the target.
While a friendly **Idolarc** is next to an enemy unit, subtract 1" from that enemy unit's Move characteristic for each **fate point** you have. This ability cannot reduce an enemy unit's Move characteristic below half its unmodified value.

abilities.name: Arcane Absorption
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.effect:
If any damage points were allocated to an enemy **^^Wizard^^** or **^^Priest^^** by this unit's attacks this turn and that enemy unit has been destroyed:
• **Heal (7)** this unit.
• Add 1 to this unit's power level for the rest of the battle.
This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

abilities.name: Thaumaturgic Hunger
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a **^^Spell^^** ability for a unit within 30" of this unit.
abilities.effect: This unit can move 6". It can move into combat and must end that move closer to the caster. If this unit was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Soul-Deep Devotion
abilities.effect:
While this unit is within a friendly non-**^^Hero^^** **^^Arcanite^^** unit's combat range:
• This unit has **Ward (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly non-**^^Hero^^** **^^Arcanite^^** unit within this unit's combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

abilities.name: Wrath of the Thaumaturge
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a friendly **^^Arcanite^^** unit in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target and in combat. This unit has charged.

abilities.name: Imbued with Arcane Fire
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^Arcanite^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target's melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)** until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Spellmaster
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **^^Spell^^** ability for a **^^Wizard^^** within 30" of this unit and the casting roll equalled or exceeded the spell's casting value and that spell has not been unbound
abilities.effect:
Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved.
If the spell is unbound, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for the rest of the phase.

abilities.name: Fates Converge
abilities.effect: While you have 6 or more **fate points**, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **^^Arcanite^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Spellmaster
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **^^Spell^^** ability for a **^^Wizard^^** within 30" of this unit and the casting roll equalled or exceeded the spell's casting value and that spell has not been unbound
abilities.effect:
Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting value, the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved.
If the spell is unbound, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for the rest of the phase.

abilities.name: Driven by Destiny
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Movement Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is more than 6" from all enemy units, it can move **X**", where **X** is the number of **fate points** you have. It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: Bound Retinue
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it is **masked by illusion**. Pick up to 1 other friendly unit that is **masked by illusion** to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up the target wholly within 6" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Long in the Planning
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Spend 2 **fate points**. Then, pick a visible friendly **^^Arcanite^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, the first time an enemy unit ends a charge move within 3" of the target, you can remove the target from the battlefield and set it up in reserve **masked by illusion**.

abilities.name: Magical Focus
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect: The next time a friendly **^^Disciples of Tzeentch^^** unit uses a **^^Spell^^** ability this phase, when picking targets for that spell, you can measure range and visibility from this terrain feature instead of from the caster, and your opponent can measure range and visibility to this terrain feature instead of to the caster for the purposes of the 'Unbind' ability.

abilities.name: Sorcerous Duplication
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
• If there is only 1 friendly **Argent Shard** on the battlefield, set up another **Argent Shard** wholly within 12" of this terrain feature, more than 1" from all other terrain features, more than 3" from all objectives and more than 9" from all enemy units.
• Remove this terrain feature from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 1" from all other terrain features, more than 3" from all objectives and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Soulbound Shield
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a **^^Spell^^** ability
abilities.effect: If this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 4+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per **^^Spell^^** ability.

abilities.name: Lord of Fate
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by friendly **^^Arcanite^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Brimstone Horror
abilities.effect: This unit's **Brimstone Horror** is a token. When this unit's **Blue Horror** is slain, place this unit's **Brimstone Horror** on the battlefield. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's **Mighty Sorcerous Bolt** while its **Brimstone Horror** is on the battlefield. If you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for this unit, remove this unit's **Brimstone Horror** from the battlefield.

abilities.name: Illusory Infiltration
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-reinforced **^^Change-cult^^** **Kairic Acolytes** units to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and not in combat.

abilities.name: Puppet on a String
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Hero^^** within 24" of and visible to a friendly **^^Change-cult Hero^^** to be the target.
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the turn, each time the target uses a **^^Core^^** ability, gain 1 **fate point**.
**Designer's Note:** *You can only gain fate points using this ability and the 'Spell-eater Pendant' ability.*

abilities.name: Silver Simulacrum
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
abilities.effect:
If there is a friendly **Argent Shard** on the battlefield, you can set up 1 additional **Argent Shard** on the battlefield. It must be set up wholly within friendly territory and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features.
**Designer's Note**: *The original Argent Shard is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the 'Deploy Faction Terrain' ability. This ability allows you to set up a second such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.*

abilities.name: Overtaken by Events
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Spend 1 **fate point**. Then, pick an enemy unit within 24" of and visible to a friendly **^^Change-cult Hero^^** to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Seeds of Discord
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Spend 1 **fate point**. Then, pick an enemy unit within 24" of and visible to a friendly **^^Change-cult Hero^^** to be the target, then pick another enemy unit within the target's combat range to be the victim.
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the target's melee weapons. Immediately resolve combat attacks for the target made with that weapon against the victim.

abilities.name: Shifting Manifestations
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare:
Pick a friendly **^^Change-cult Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly **^^Manifestations^^** below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
• **Burning Sigil of Tzeentch**
• **Daemonic Simulacrum**
• **Tome of Eyes**
abilities.effect: If there is already a friendly **^^Manifestation^^** from the list above on the battlefield, it is immediately banished and removed from play. Then, set up the **^^Manifestation^^** you picked within 1" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Eldritch Strength
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Change-cult Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Change-cult^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target's attacks until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Spell-eater Pendant
abilities.effect: Each time this unit unbinds a spell or banishes an enemy **^^Manifestation^^**, gain 1 **fate point**.

abilities.name: Call of Anarchy
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a terrain feature within 18" of this unit, then pick a friendly non-**^^Hero Change-cult^^** unit that is **masked by illusion** or that has been destroyed to be the target.
abilities.effect:
If you picked a unit that is **masked by illusion**, set it up wholly within 3" of that terrain feature and more than 6" from all enemy units.
If you picked a unit that has been destroyed, set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 3" of that terrain feature and more than 6" from all enemy units.
**Designer's Note:** *Units can be set up in reserve masked by illusion using the Fatemaster's 'Long in the Planning' ability.

***Change the Past:*** Pick an enemy unit within 12" of and visible to the caster, that is in combat and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target. Roll either 4 dice or a number of dice equal to the number of unspent **destiny dice** you have. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
***Seize the Present:*** Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly **^^Oracles of Fate^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of the caster.
***Predict the Future:*** Roll a dice. You must replace 1 of your **destiny dice** with that roll.

abilities.name: Corrupted Leystone
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is contesting an objective, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again contesting an objective and more than 7" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Nexus of Fate
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If you have 9 unspent **destiny dice**, you must replace 1 of your **destiny dice** with that roll. Otherwise, place that dice to one side as a **destiny dice**.

units.name: Abhorrant Ghoul King on Royal Zombie Dragon

abilities.name: Necromantic Limits
abilities.effect:
This unit's **Draconic Claws** have a maximum Attacks characteristic of 10.
While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Draconic Claws** is 5.

abilities.name: Monstrous Hunger
abilities.effect: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly non-**^^Hero Flesh-eater Courts Monsters^^** can use **^^Charge^^** abilities even if they used a Run ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: Draconic Terror
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target's Control characteristic, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Necromantic Limits
abilities.effect:
This unit's **Terrorgheist's Skeletal Talons** have a maximum Attacks characteristic of 10.

abilities.name: Wicked Predator
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For each champion, standard bearer, and musician in the target unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Terrorgheist's Skeletal Talons**, to a maximum of 10, for the rest of the phase. Those additional attacks must target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Ferocious Hunger
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with this unit's **Companion** melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Monstrous Talons** is 4.

abilities.name: Shroudcage Fragment
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. If the roll exceeds the target's Control characteristic, the target has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Epicentre of Delusion
abilities.effect: Each time you make a delusion roll, you can add 1 or subtract 1 from the roll.

abilities.name: Glimpse of Delusion
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy model within 18" of this unit to be the target, pick another enemy unit that is visible to the target and within the target's combat range to be the victim, then make a casting roll of 2D6. You can only pick the target's unit to be the victim if that unit has 2 or more models.
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the target's melee weapons. Immediately resolve combat attacks made with that weapon against the victim.

abilities.name: Insular Contemplations
abilities.effect: While this unit is more than 6" from all enemy units, add 1 to chanting rolls for this unit.

abilities.name: Lord of the Marches
abilities.timing: Deployment Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit and up to 2 friendly **^^Flesh-eater Courts^^** units in this unit's regiment that have not been deployed to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Set up the target units in reserve **patrolling the borders**. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: Trespassers!
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it is **patrolling the borders**, then pick an enemy unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit more than 6" from the target and more than 9" from all other enemy units. Then, set up the units that were **patrolling the borders** with this unit wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Predator Knights
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Enemy Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, this unit can use a **^^Retreat^^** ability as if it were your movement phase. No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by that **^^Retreat^^** ability.

abilities.name: Infected
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a command, **^^Spell^^** ability or **^^Prayer^^** ability for an **^^Infected^^** unit
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 5+:
• If they declared a command, that command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.
• If they declared a **^^Spell^^** or **^^Prayer^^** ability, that spell or prayer fails.
This reaction can be used more than once per phase but only once per command, **^^Spell^^** ability or **^^Prayer^^** ability.

abilities.name: The King's Entreaty
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, your opponent must decide whether the target will accept or reject the entreaty offered by this unit.
***Accept:*** The target has the **^^Infected^^** keyword for the rest of the battle.
***Reject:*** The target has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Mind-shattering Cacophony
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit's **Piercing Death Screech** to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of ranged weapons used by friendly **Crypt Flayers** units for attacks that target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: On Winged Steeds
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **Crypt Flayers** ability that used the 'To Our Liege' ability this turn and is wholly within 9" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target can immediately move D3" but cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Serfs^^** or **^^Knights^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:
• If the target is a **^^Serfs^^** unit, return up to 3 slain models to it.
• If the target is a **^^Knights^^** unit, return 1 slain model to it.

abilities.name: Victory Feast
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.effect:
If any models were slain by this unit this turn:
• **Heal (D6)** this unit.
• If this unit is in combat, this unit can immediately move 10". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat with the units it was already in combat with at the start of the move.
• If that unit is not in combat, this unit can immediately move 10" but cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^Flesh-eater Courts^^** **^^Priest^^** wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:

• When picking targets for that prayer, you can measure range and visibility from this unit instead of from the chanter.
• Add 1 to the chanting roll for that prayer.

abilities.effect:
While this terrain feature has a Steward:
• The Steward cannot use **^^Move^^** abilities.
• Instead of measuring range or visibility to the Steward, measure to this terrain feature instead.
• All attacks that would target the Steward target this terrain feature instead.
• If this terrain feature is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the Steward. Then, set up the Steward on the battlefield within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer the Steward. If it is not possible to set up the Steward, it is slain.

abilities.declare: If this terrain feature does not have a Steward, pick a friendly **^^Flesh-eater Courts Infantry Hero^^** within 3" of it and not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Place the target on this terrain feature. The target is now the Steward (see 'Steward of the Realm').

abilities.effect: The target can move D3". If the target was set up this turn, it can move D6" instead. It cannot move into combat during that move.

abilities.name: Duty Calls
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: If this terrain feature has a Steward that was not placed on it this turn, set up the Steward on the battlefield wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer the Steward.

***Refuse:*** The target has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.

**Battle Round 2:** 12"
**Battle Round 3:** 15"
**Battle Round 4:** 18"

abilities.name: Thricefold Court

abilities.effect:

***Sins of Soul:*** While an enemy **^^Wizard^^** or **^^Priest^^** is visible to this unit, add 1 to this unit's power level.


***Sins of Flesh:*** This unit's attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.


***Sins of Mind:*** Each time a visible friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you receive 3 additional rally points.

abilities.declare: Pick either a visible friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh Infantry^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit or a visible enemy unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect:

abilities.name: Slavering for Sensation

abilities.declare: Pick up to 2 friendly **Hellflayer** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of this unit and each target for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Soulscent

abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units that this unit passed across this phase to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If any models are slain by this ability, this unit has **^^Ward (5+)^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Threshing Doom
abilities.effect: When this unit moves, it can pass through models in enemy **^^Infantry^^** units and can pass through the combat ranges of enemy **^^Infantry^^** units, but it cannot end a move in combat unless specified in the ability used.

abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **Seeker Chariot** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit and the targets for the rest of the turn. In addition, for the rest of the turn, when this unit and the targets use the 'Mutilating Blades' ability, add 1 to the amount of mortal damage inflicted (if any).

abilities.name: Mutilating Blades

abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

abilities.name: Lithe and Swift

abilities.name: Excess of Blades

abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the unmodified charge roll for that **^^Charge^^** ability. For each roll that exceeds the target's Save characteristic, the target suffers 1 mortal damage.

abilities.name: The More Glorious Slaughter

abilities.declare: If a friendly **^^Twin^^** destroyed an enemy unit in the previous turn and the other did not, pick the one that did not to use this ability.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by units in the regiment of the unit using this abiltiy.

abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the unit using this ability is contesting an objective you control, add 5 to the control scores of units in its regiment.

abilities.name: The Grander Visage

abilities.declare: If either friendly **^^Twin^^** is damaged, pick the one with fewer or no damage points to use this ability.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, the unit using this ability has **^^Ward (4+)^^**.

abilities.name: The Voice and the Talon

abilities.name: The Swifter Surge

abilities.effect: For the rest of the phase, when making charge rolls for units in the regiment of the unit using this ability, add 1 to the number of dice rolled. to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.

abilities.name: The More Cunning Ruse
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: If both friendly **^^Twins^^** are within 12" of and visible to each other, pick 1 of them to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Remove the unit using this ability from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: The Triplet Trinket
abilities.effect:
While a friendly **^^Twin^^** is within 3" of and visible to this unit, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that **^^Twin^^** and this unit.
While 2 friendly **^^Twins^^** are within 3" of and visible to this unit, subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks that target those **^^Twins^^** and this unit instead.

abilities.name: Tethered to the Twins
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Twin^^** that has been destroyed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Court of the Godlings Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while a friendly **^^Twin^^** is visible to the target, halve the target's Move characteristic. In addition, while 2 friendly **^^Twins^^** are visible to the target, your opponent must roll 1 fewer dice, to a minimum of 1, when making charge rolls for it.

abilities.name: Estatic Furore
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Court of the Godlings Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Twin^^** wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to wound rolls made by friendly **^^Court of the Godlings^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to the target.

abilities.name: Shardslash

abilities.effect:

abilities.name: Paragon Of Vainglory
abilities.effect:
If this unit charged this turn and the unmodified charge roll was 6+ for the rest of the turn:

• Melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, used by other friendly **^^Hedonites of Slaanesh^^** units have **Crit (2 Hits) while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.

abilities.name: The Mirror's Depths
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
If the target is within 6" of this unit, the target is **gazing into eternity** until the start of your next turn. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, the target is **gazing into eternity** until the start of your next turn.


While the target is **gazing into eternity**, it must end all moves no further from this unit than it was at the start of the move and it cannot be removed from the battlefield by an ability that would allow it to be set up again on the battlefield.


**Designer's Note:** *This includes pile-in moves.*

abilities.name: Swallow Energy

abilities.declare: Pick a visible **^^Manifestation^^** within 12" of this unit and that was not summoned this turn to be the target, then make a banishment roll of 2D6.

abilities.declare: If this unit is a **^^Paragon^^**, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of it to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target.

It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat. If this unit was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat with the units it was already in combat with at the start of the move.

If any damage points are allocated to an enemy unit by attacks made by this unit, that enemy unit is **krump'd** until the start of your next turn.
While a unit is **krump'd**:

• Subtract 1 for save rolls for that unit.
• Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for that unit.

abilities.name: Oi! Back To It!
abilities.effect: If a friendly **^^Zoggrok's Ironmongers^^ Ardboyz** or **^^Brutes^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

abilities.name: Summon Gork-Roara
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Gork-Roara** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Ironjawz Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a **Gork-Roara** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Get 'Em, Gork!
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Zoggrok's Ironmongerz Priest^^** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect:
If the chanting roll was 5-9, pick a visible terrain feature wholly within 12" of the chanter. If the chanting roll was 10+, pick a visible terrain feature wholly within 18" of the chanter instead. That terrain feature is **trampled by Gork** for the rest of the battle.
Roll a D3 each time an enemy unit ends a move within 6" of a terrain feature that is **trampled by Gork**. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the enemy unit equal to the roll.

abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target's ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Atmospheric Isolation
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from charge rolls for enemy units within 9" of this unit.

abilities.name: Long-line Slings

abilities.name: Transport Capacity
