abilities.effect: Add 6" to the Range characteristic of this unit's **Starshard Bolts** while it is wholly within 12" of any friendly **Vanari Auralan Sentinels** units.

abilities.name: Dawnrider Charge
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's **Dawnrider Lances and Blades** if it charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: Lead the Charge
abilities.effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for friendly **^^Lumineth Realm-lords^^** units while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.

abilities.name: Purest Aetherquartz
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's attacks and subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.

abilities.name: Lofted Shots
abilities.timing: Your Shooting Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 6" to the Range characteristic of this unit's **Auralan Bows** but subtract 1 from hit rolls for this unit's shooting attacks.

abilities.name: Masters of Combat
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's **Sunmental Blades** for each instance of **Varinor, Rune of Strength** depicted on your **battle scripture**.

abilities.name: Guardians of the Scinari
abilities.effect: While any friendly **^^Scinari Heroes^^** are wholly within this unit's combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have **^^Ward (5+)^^**.

abilities.name: World Banner
abilities.effect: While a visible friendly **^^Lumineth Realm-lords^^** unit is wholly within 12" of this unit, it can use the 'Rally' command even if it is in combat.

abilities.name: Supreme Swordmaster
abilities.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit's attacks.

abilities.name: Valorous Intervention
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: This unit cannot use this ability if it is in combat. Pick a friendly **^^Lumineth Realm-lords^^** unit that is in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target, within 1" of an enemy unit and in combat. This unit has charged.

abilities.name: Anticipated Strike
abilities.effect: If this unit has not charged this turn, ignore the effect of the **Charge (+1 Damage)** ability for combat attacks made by enemy units that target this unit.

abilities.name: Shrine Guardian
abilities.effect:
While this terrain feature has a Shrine Guardian:
• This terrain feature has a Move characteristic of 6" and can use non-command non-**^^Charge^^** **^^Move^^** abilities as if it were a unit. It cannot end a **^^Move^^** ability within the combat range of an enemy unit.
• The Shrine Guardian cannot use **^^Move^^** abilities and remains on this terrain feature each time it moves.
• Instead of measuring range or visibility to the Shrine Guardian, measure to this terrain feature instead.
• All attacks that would target the Shrine Guardian target this terrain feature instead.
• If this terrain feature is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the Shrine Guardian. Then, set up the Shrine Guardian on the battlefield wholly within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer a Shrine Guardian. If it is not possible to set up the Shrine Guardian, it is slain.

abilities.name: Enter the Shrine
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: If this terrain feature does not have a Shrine Guardian, pick a friendly **^^Lumineth Realm‑lords Infantry Hero^^** within 3" of it and not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Place the target on this terrain feature. The target is now a Shrine Guardian (see 'Shrine Guardian').

abilities.name: Cleansing Rituals
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared a **^^Spell^^** ability for a **^^Lumineth Realm-lords^^** unit wholly within 12" of this terrain feature
abilities.effect: While this terrain feature has a Shrine Guardian, you can re-roll the casting roll for that spell.

abilities.name: Exit the Shrine
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: If this terrain feature has a Shrine Guardian that was not placed on it this turn, set up the Shrine Guardian on the battlefield wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer a Shrine Guardian.

abilities.name: Shining Example
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly **^^Lumineth Realm-lords^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

abilities.name: Wall of Blades
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **Vanari Auralan Wardens** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the wall of blades. Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the wall of blades to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the wall of blades that is within 3" of the target. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Rewards of Valour
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Unique Vanari Hero^^** that does not have an artefact of power to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Give the target 1 artefact of power from the 'Vanari Paragons' Army of Renown rules.
**Designer's Note:** *This artefact of power is given to the* **^^Hero^^** *during the deployment phase, not during army composition.*

abilities.name: Labour of Control
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: You can only use this ability if there is at least 1 different friendly unit within 6" of each battlefield edge.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the number of **labours** you have completed. For the rest of the battle, add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **^^Lumineth Realm-lords^^** units.

abilities.name: Labour of Might
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: You can only use this ability if 3 or more enemy units have been destroyed this battle.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the number of **labours** you have completed. For the rest of the battle, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^Lumineth Realm-lords^^** units.

abilities.name: Labour of Control
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: You can only use this ability if there are no enemy units with an artefact of power on the battlefield.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the number of **labours** you have completed. For the rest of the battle, add 10 to the control scores of friendly **^^Lumineth Realm-lords^^** units.

abilities.name: Blessing of Tyrion
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: You can only use this ability if you have completed 3 **labours**.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle, friendly **^^Lumineth Realm-lords^^** units have **^^Ward (5+)^^**.

abilities.name: Swiftfeather Talisman
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Lumineth Realm-lords^^** unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Add 2" to the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Phoenix Blade
abilities.effect: This unit's combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

abilities.name: Nullstone Beads
abilities.effect: This unit can use the 'Unbind' ability as if it had **^^Wizard (1)^^**.

abilities.name: Master Duellist
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy **^^Hero^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 4+:
• If the target has an artefact of power, it no longer has that artefact of power.
• The target has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Sevenfold Slaughter
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **Rotswords** unit that did not charge this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's **Ruined Master-crafted Weapons** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Lord of the Infected Legions
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **Rotswords** units that did not charge this turn while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Ghurk's Tentacle** is 3.

abilities.name: Blighted Stampede
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared the 'Counter-charge' command for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick up to 2 friendly **^^Maggotkin of Nurgle^^** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets. After the 'Counter-charge' command for this unit has been resolved, if this unit charged, each of the targets can immediately use the 'Counter-charge' command in an order of your choosing without any command points being spent.

abilities.name: Overgrowth of Flesh
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the target's Health characteristic. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target, to a maximum of 7 mortal damage. If any mortal damage was inflicted on the target, and the target was not a **^^Manifestation^^** or terrain feature, it has the **^^Diseased^^** keyword.

abilities.name: Horrific Opponent
abilities.effect: Subtract 5 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Tentacle Trap
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Hero^^** or **^^Monster^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 4+, for the rest of the turn:
• The target cannot move and cannot be removed from the battlefield by an ability that would allow it to be set up elsewhere on the battlefield. 
• Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks that target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Discomfiting Stench
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy **^^Wizard^^** or **^^Priest^^** within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice.
• If the target is a **^^Wizard^^** and the roll exceeds the target's power level, until the start of your next turn, each time a casting roll for the target includes 2 or more rolls of 1, 2 or more rolls of 2 or 2 or more rolls of 3, the spell is miscast.
• If the target is a **^^Priest^^** and the roll exceeds the target's power level, until the start of your next turn, each time your opponent makes an unmodified chanting roll of 1 or 2 for the target, the prayer fails, its effect is not resolved and your opponent must remove D3 ritual points from the target. In addition, your opponent cannot give that **^^Priest^^** any ritual points for the rest of the phase.

abilities.name: Putrescent Piety
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
abilities.effect: This unit has **^^Priest^^ (1)** for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Disgustingly Devoted
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent's **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, give this unit D3 ritual points.

abilities.name: Relentless Attackers
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's **Flyrider's Arsenal** for attacks that target enemy units contesting an objective.

abilities.name: Dispersed Formation
abilities.effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

abilities.name: Pestilential Beachhead
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it is **aboard the Slime Fleet**.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield, wholly within 7" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then set up every other friendly unit that is **aboard the Slime Fleet** on the battlefield wholly within 7" of a battlefield edge, wholly within 7" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Flailing Tentacles
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Infantry Hero^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Master of the Slime Fleet
abilities.timing: Deployment Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a regiment led by this unit to be the target if no units from that regiment have been deployed.
abilities.effect: Each unit in the target regiment is set up in reserve **aboard the Slime Fleet**. Those units have now been deployed.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Tripletongue's Claws** is 3.

abilities.name: Gigantic Nurgling-kin
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: **Heal (X) this unit**, where X is half the number of damage points this unit has (rounding up).

abilities.name: Tide of Nurglings
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up tp 2 friendly **Nurglings** unit wholly within 12" of this unit's to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice for each target. On a 2+:
• If the target is not in combat, it can move a number of inches equal to the roll but cannot end that move in combat.
• If the target is in combat, it can make a pile-in move.

abilities.name: Lord of Nurglings
abilities.effect:
While any friendly **Nurglings** units are wholly within 12" of this unit:
• Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to that **Nurglings* unit each phase.
• That **Nurglings** unit can ignore the effect of the 'Beast' ability.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Bilespurter's Claws** is 3.

abilities.name: Daemon Flies
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Monster^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Miasma of Pestilence
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, other than the **Companion** ability, weapon abilities for attacks that target that friendly unit have no effect.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Whippermaw's Claws** is 3.

abilities.name: Grasping Tongue
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^Maggotkin of Nurgle^^** units that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Acid Ichor
abilities.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **^^Fight^^** ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Tainted Sorceries
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that was picked to be the target of a spell that was successfully cast by this unit this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, subtract 1 from ward rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Master of Rot Flies
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick this unit and up to 2 friendly **Pusgoyle Blightlords** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the targets' **Rot Fly's Mouthparts and Sting** melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Vectors of Foulest Contagion
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Knell of Doom
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. If the target is within 6" of a friendly **Sloven Knights** unit, you can roll a D6 instead. If the roll equals or exceeds the target's Control characteristic, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's attacks until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Omens of Decay
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Subtract twice the current battle round number from the target's control score for the rest of the turn. If the chanting roll was 10+, this ability affects all enemy units within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Thrice-ripened Death's Heads
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit or with a friendly **Plague Drones** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll D3. On 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Festering Bulwark
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit and a friendly **Putrid Blightkings** unit within 3" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for the targets for the rest of the turn

abilities.name: Virulent Concoctions
abilities.effect: When picking an enemy unit to be the target of the 'infect' effect of the 'Blessed by the Plaguefather' ability, you can pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it by this unit's shooting attacks this turn to be the target, even if that unit is not within 7" of any friendly **^^Maggotkin of Nurgle^^** units. You cannot pick a **^^Manifestation^^** or terrain feature.

abilities.name: Rot-Blossom
abilities.effect: Friendly **^^Rotbringers^^** units have **^^Ward (5+)^^** while they are wholly within 12" of this terrain feature.

abilities.name: Tendrils of Corruption
abilities.timing: Any Movement Phase
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the phase, this terrain feature has a Move characteristic of 3" and can immediately move 3". It cannot move through or end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units and it cannot end that move on an objective or another terrain feature.
**Designer's Note:** *This terrain feature cannot use* **^^Move^^**, **^^Run^^***,* **^^Retreat^^** *or* **^^Charge^^** *abilities.*

abilities.name: Riddled With Disease
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly **^^Maggotkin of Nurgle Daemon^^** unit wholly within 12" of this terrain feature uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 1 additional rally roll of D6. If that unit is a non-**^^Hero^^** unit, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6 instead.

abilities.name: Purulent Profusion
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of the target's melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Rampant Defilement
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **Pestigors** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Bestial Desecration
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's melee weapons while it is not within enemy territory.

abilities.name: Pall of Exhaustion
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is in combat with any other friendly **^^Rotbringers^^** units. On a 3+, the target has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Indolent Bludgeoning
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, while the target is in combat with both this unit and another friendly **^^Maggotkin of Nurgle^^** unit, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's melee weapons for attacks that target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Mire Kelpies
abilities.effect: This unit's **Mire Kelpies** are tokens. There are 6 **Mire Kelpies** for every 14 models in this unit.

abilities.name: Contagious Catarrh
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: If this unit has any **Mire Kelpies**, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target. You cannot pick a **^^Manifestation^^** or terrain feature.
abilities.effect: Pick any number of this unit's **Mire Kelpies** and remove them from the battlefield. Then, roll a dice, adding 1 to the roll for each **Mire Kelpie** you removed this phase. On an unmodified roll of 1, this ability has no effect. On a 6+, the target has the **^^Diseased^^** keyword.

abilities.name: Ruptured Cysts
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible **^^Diseased^^** enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, inflict 1 mortal damage on each other **^^Diseased^^** enemy unit within 3" of the target. If the chanting roll is 9+, you can also pick a friendly **Plaguebearers** unit within 12" of the target. For each enemy **^^Infantry^^** model slain by this ability this turn, you can return 1 slain model to that friendly unit.

abilities.name: Scry the Filth
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:
• Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **^^Maggotkin of Nurgle Wizards^^** while they are within 3" of this unit.
• Add 1 to chanting rolls for friendly **^^Maggotkin of Nurgle Priests^^** while they are within 3" of this unit.

abilities.name: Sweat-Soaked and Reeking
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Retchling
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit's **Fecula Flyblown** is on the battlefield, add 1 to its power level for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Fecula Flyblown
abilities.effect: While this unit's **Fecula Flyblown** is on the battlefield, it has **^^Wizard (1)^^**.

abilities.name: Scumboil Pox
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy **^^Wizard^^** or **^^Priest^^** within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from the target's power level, to a minimum of 0, until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Delightful Brews, Splendid Restoratives
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible unit within this unit's combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: If the target is a friendly **^^Maggotkin of Nurgle^^** unit, **Heal (D3)** the target. If the target is an enemy unit, roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Revolution and Revulsion
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: You must use this ability at the start of each battle round.
abilities.effect:
If it is the first battle round, roll a dice to determine which **^^Cycle^^** ability is ripe for the rest of the battle round.
**1** 'Unnatural Fecundity'
**2** 'Fecund Vigour'
**3** 'Burgeoning Filth'
**4** 'Plague of Misery'
**5** 'Nauseous Revulsion'
**6** 'Rampant Disease'
**7** 'Corrupted Regrowth'
If it is not the first battle round, the next **^^Cycle^^** ability in the sequence is ripe for the rest of the battle round. If the 'Corrupted Regrowth' ability was ripe last battle round, the 'Unnatural Vitality' ability is ripe this battle round.
You can only use a **^^Cycle^^** ability if it is ripe. Only 1 **^^Cycle^^** ability is ripe each battle round.

abilities.name: Unnatural Vitality
abilities.effect: Friendly non-^^**Monster Cycle of Corruption Heroes^^** have **^^Ward (4+)^^**.

abilities.name: Fecund Vigour
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: **Heal (D3)** each friendly **^^Cycle of Corruption^^** unit.

abilities.name: Burgeoning Filth
abilities.effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units wihle they are in combat with any friendly **^^Cycle of Corruption^^** units.

abilities.name: Plague of Misery
abilities.effect: While enemy units are within 12" of any friendly 'Cycle of Corruption' units, they cannot use abilities that heal or return slain models to a unit.

abilities.name: Nauseous Revulsion
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from charge rolls for enemy units.

abilities.name: Rampant Disease
abilities.effect: Melee weapons used by friendly non-**^^Hero Cycle of Corruption^^** units have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

abilities.name: Corrupted Regrowth
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
**Heal (7)** each friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaw**.
If there are no friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaws** on the battlefield, you can set up a **Feculent Gnarlmaw** on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features.

abilities.name: Cankerous Nail
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's melee weapons.

abilities.name: Utterly Disgusting
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.

abilities.name: Bacterial Blessing
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Cycle of Corruption Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Cycle of Corruption^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks. If the chanting roll was 7+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

abilities.name: Ever Turning
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Cycle of Corruption Priest^^** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: The next **^^Cycle^^** ability in the sequence is ripe for the rest of the battle round instead of the current **^^Cycle^^** ability. If the chanting roll was 12+, you can pick which **^^Cycle^^** ability is ripe.

abilities.name: Virulent Agonies
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Cycle of Corruption Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, inflict 1 mortal damage on each other enemy unit within the target's combat range, If the chanting roll was 7+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target instead of 1.

abilities.name: Epidermal Crustitis
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Cycle of Corruption Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of melee weapons used for attacks that target the caster.

abilities.name: Rank and Vile
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Cycle of Corruption Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy **^^Infantry^^** unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a model in the target unit is slain, after removing it from the battlefield, roll a dice. On a 4+, return 1 slain model to a friendly non-**^^Hero Cycle of Corruption Infantry^^** unit within 6" of the target.

abilities.name: Spittledrain
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Cycle of Corruption Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from the target's Move characteristic until the start of your next turn. Then, roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target, to a maximum of 7.

abilities.name: Cultivating the Garden of Nurgle
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: If there is no more than 1 friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaw** on the battlefield, you can set up a **Feculent Gnarlmaw** wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 3" from all enemy units, objectives and other terrain features.

abilities.name: Beast Handler
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **Beast of Nurgle** unit that has been destroyed.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, set up a replacement unit wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Gnarlmaw Whisperer
abilities.timing: End of Your Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaw** to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 3" from all enemy units, objectives, and other terrain features.

abilities.name: Bloated With Corruption
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: If this unit is damaged, pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Plague Wind
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target. You cannot pick a **^^Manifestation^^** or terrain feature. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: The target has the **^^Diseased^^** keyword.

abilities.name: Locus of Nurgle
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Maggotkin of Nurgle Daemon^^** unit that started the battle with 3 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 6" of this unit or a friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaw** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Colossal Blight Weapons** is 3.

abilities.name: Keep Counting, I'm Watching You
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **Plaguebearers** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 2+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:
***Tally of Blows:*** Add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks.
***Recorded Stamina:*** Add 5 to the target's control score.

abilities.name: Stupefying Sneezes
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Monster^^** that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by this unit's shooting attacks to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target cannot use **^^Rampage^^** abilities until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Jolly Gutpipes
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^Maggotkin of Nurgle Daemon^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit or a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
If you picked a friendly unit to be the target, roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target's Control characteristic, add 2 to run rolls and charge rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.
If you picked an enemy unit to be the target, roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target's Control characteristic, until the start of your next turn, while this unit is on the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target:
• Each time the target ends a move further from this unit than it was at the start of the move, after the ability used by the target has been resolved.
• Each time the target is removed from the battlefield and set up again on the battlefield further from the unit than it was before it was removed, after the ability used by the target has been resolved.

abilities.name: Attention Seekers
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick the closest enemy unit to it to be the target. If 2 or more enemy units are tied to be the closest, you can pick which is the target. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: This unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. During that move, this unit can move into combat and can pass through models in the target unit, but it must end that move within 1/2" of the target. Then, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If it does so, this unit has charged.

abilities.name: Endless Swarm
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it has been destroyed.
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit wholly within 6" of a friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaw** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Gnarlrod** is 3.

abilities.name: Mountain of Loathsome Flesh
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Bringer of Plenty
abilities.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **^^Maggotkin of Nurgle^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Deluge of Nurgle
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick each enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the enemy targets, then pick each friendly **^^Maggotkin of Nurgle^^** unit within 18" of this unit to be the friendly targets. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Inflict 1 mortal damage on each enemy target and **Heal (1)** each friendly target. Then, until the start of your next turn, if an ability would heal or return any slain models to an enemy unit while they are within 18" of this unit, that ability does not heal any damage points or return any slain models to it.

abilities.name: Captain of the Plague Legions
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^Fight^^** ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly **Plaguebearers** unit that has not used a **^^Fight^^** ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **^^Fight^^** ability immediately after the **^^Fight^^** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Ripe Pastures
abilities.effect: This unit can use **^^Charge^^** abilities even if it used a **^^Retreat^^** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **^^Retreat^^** abilities.

abilities.name: Dispersed Formation
abilities.effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

abilities.name: Cloud of Flies
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit while it is contesting an objective you control.

abilities.name: Rot-Blossom
abilities.effect: Friendly **^^Rotbringers^^** units have **^^Ward (5+)^^** while they are wholly within 12" of this terrain feature.

abilities.name: Tendrils of Corruption
abilities.timing: Any Movement Phase
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the phase, this terrain feature has a Move characteristic of 3" and can immediately move 3". It cannot move through or end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units and it cannot end that move on an objective or another terrain feature.
**Designer's Note:** *This terrain feature cannot use* **^^Move^^**, **^^Run^^***,* **^^Retreat^^** *or* **^^Charge^^** *abilities.*

abilities.name: Riddled With Disease
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly **^^Maggotkin of Nurgle Daemon^^** unit wholly within 12" of this terrain feature uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 1 additional rally roll of D6. If that unit is a non-**^^Hero^^** unit, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6 instead.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Gathoblyt's Fanged Maw** is 3.

abilities.name: Vile Poisons and Debilitating Toxins
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit did not charge this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. You cannot pick a **^^Manifestation^^** or terrain feature.
abilities.effect:
You and your opponent must roll off. Add this unit's Control characteristic to your roll and the target's Control characteristic to your opponent's roll. If your roll is higher, apply the corresponding effect:
• If the target is a **^^Hero^^** or **^^Monster^^**, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the difference between your roll and your opponent's roll.
• If the target is a non-**^^Hero^^** non-**^^Monster^^** unit, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

abilities.name: Annelid Engorgement
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: For each enemy unit that was in combat with this unit this turn and was destroyed this turn, this unit gains D3 **leech points** for the rest of the battle. Until the end of the next turn, add 1 to this unit's Control characteristic for each leech point it currently has.

abilities.name: The Leechlord's Curse
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: This unit gains 1 **leech point** for the rest of the battle. Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a **^^Core^^** ability or command, after that ability has been resolved, roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, if any damage points were allocated to the target by this ability, **Heal (1)** this unit.

units.name: Gelgus Pust, the Prince of Sores

abilities.name: Grin of the Grandfather
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice for each target. If the roll equals or exceeds the target's Control characteristic, pick 1 of the following to apply for the rest of the turn:
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target's combat attacks.
• Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's combat attacks.
• Subtract 1 from the target's Control characteristic.

abilities.name: Parasitic Infestation
abilities.timing: Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick each enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Polluting Aura
abilities.effect:
While a friendly **^^Maggotkin of Nurgle^^** unit is wholly within 6" of a **^^Polluted^^** terrain feature, each time that unit uses or is the target of an ability that would heal 1 or more damage points, add 1 to the number of damage points healed.
While an enemy unit is within 6" of a **^^Polluted^^** terrain feature, each time that unit uses or is the target of an ability that would heal 1 or more damage points, subtract 1 from the number of damage points healed, to a minimum of 0.

abilities.name: Master Contaminator
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a terrain feature within 6" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target is considered by you to be **^^Polluted^^** for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Utter Defilement
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: This unit's **Pestilent Pollutants** are tokens. This unit has 2 **Pestilent Pollutants**. Pick an objective or terrain feature within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Place 2 of this unit's **Pestilent Pollutants** next to the target. If both of this unit's **Pestilent Pollutants** are already on the battlefield, pick 1 of them, remove it from the battlefield and place it next to the target instead.

abilities.name: From the Tainted Earth
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect:
Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again more than 9" from all enemy units and wholly within 3" of:
• An objective or terrain feature that has a friendly **Pestilent Pollutant**, or
• A **^^Polluted^^** terrain feature (see Gelgus Pust's 'Master Contaminator' ability), or
• An objective you control

abilities.name: Entropy Endures
abilities.effect: If this unit has 2 models and would be automatically destroyed, it is not automatically destroyed. Instead, 1 model in this unit is slain.

abilities.name: Tallyman of Nurgle
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect:
You gain a number of **tally points** equal to the current battle round number.
During the battle round, you can spend your **tally points**. For each **tally point** you spend, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll, 1 save roll or 1 ward roll for a friendly **^^Maggotkin of Nurgle^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit.
At the end of the battle round, any unspent **tally points** are lost.

abilities.name: Seeds of Rot
abilities.effect: When using the 'Blessed by the Plaguefather' ability, if you choose to infect an enemy unit, you can pick an enemy unit that is contesting an objective that is **seeded with rot**.

abilities.name: Blooming Plague
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an objective that is contested by this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target is **seeded with rot** for the rest of the battle.

abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again within 3" of a friendly **^^Gardeners of Nurgle Hero^^** and more than 3" from all enemy units, objectives, and other terrain features.

abilities.effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **^^Gardeners of Nurgle^^** **Beasts of Nurgle** and **Plague Drones** units while they are wholly within 6" of any friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaws**.

abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the target is wholly within 12" of any friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaws**, ward rolls cannot be made for enemy units in combat with the target.

abilities.name: Stinking Sporeseed

abilities.name: Foetid Orchardist

abilities.name: Grim Justice

abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

abilities.name: The Maw Opens
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^Ogor Mawtribes^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect:
If the target is not in combat, it can move up to D3+3" but must end that move no further from the nearest enemy unit that is visible to it. It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

If the target is in combat, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with the target, then **Heal (D3)** the target. If the target is a **^^Mawseekers^^** unit, instead inflict 3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with the target, then **Heal (3)** the target.

abilities.name: A Taste for the Arcane
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect:
If a friendly or enemy **^^Wizard^^** or **^^Priest^^** is within 6" of this unit, roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:
• This unit's melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)**.
• If this unit's melee weapons already have **Crit (2 Hits)**, they have **Crit (Mortal)**.

abilities.name: Arcane Contortions
abilities.effect:
Subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for visible enemy units while they are within 12" of this unit.

Add 1 to casting rolls for visible friendly **^^Mawseekers Wizards^^** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Conduits of Gut Magic
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Measure the range and visibility of the next **^^Spell^^** ability used by a friendly **^^Ogor Mawtribes Wizard^^** that is wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit from this unit instead of that **^^Wizard^^**. This unit is treated as the caster for the purpose of other abilities or spell effects, such as 'Unbind'.

abilities.name: Prepare the Feast
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilities.effect: If there is no friendly **Feastmaster** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Gollop Hero^^** to be the **Feastmaster** for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Ooh, That Looks Tasty...
abilities.effect:
Each time an enemy unit is destroyed, you gain a number of **raw ingredients**.

The number of **raw ingredients** yielded by a destroyed unit is the Health characteristic of that unit multiplied by the number of starting models in that unit.

***Designer's Note**: If a destroyed enemy unit had a Health characteristic of 2 and its starting size was 10 models, it would yield 20 raw ingredients when it was destroyed.*

abilities.name: Gland Goulash
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Spend 10 **raw ingredients**.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, when making casting rolls and unbinding rolls for friendly **^^Gollop^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **Feastmaster**.

abilities.name: Bone-Slurry Soup
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Spend 5 **raw ingredients**.
abilities.effect: Heal (D6) each friendly **^^Gollop^^** unit that is wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **Feastmaster**.

abilities.name: The Organ Platter
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Spend 20 **raw ingredients**.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the phase, while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly **Feastmaster**, melee weapons used by friendly **^^Gollop^^** units have **Crit (Mortal)**.

abilities.name: Gore-Offal Dumplings
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Spend 10 **raw ingredients**.
abilities.effect: Each friendly **^^Gollop^^** unit that is wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **Feastmaster** can immediately use a **^^Charge^^** ability as if it were your charge phase, but subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making the charge roll for that unit.

abilities.name: Unwashed Innards
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Spend 5 **raw ingredients**.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 4 to run rolls for friendly **^^Gollop^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **Feastmaster**.

abilities.name: Fried Limbs
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Spend 10 **raw ingredients**.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 3 to charge rolls for friendly **^^Gollop^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **Feastmaster**.

abilities.name: Overflowing Larder
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Gain D6 **raw ingredients**. If this unit is a **Feastmaster**, gain D3+3 **raw ingredients** instead.

abilities.name: Indomitable Guts
abilities.effect: Add 1 to ward rolls for this unit.

abilities.name: Bonecruncher
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Gollop Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Gain a number of **raw ingredients** equal to the number of those damage points that are allocated to the target.

abilities.name: Bloodgruel
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Gollop Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Gollop^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
• Return 1 slain model to the target.
• **Heal (D6)** the target.

abilities.name: The Cosmos Writhes
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Gollop Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Gollop^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Wall of Meat
abilities.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for this unit if it has not charged this turn.

abilities.name: Obliterating Blast
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit has not used a **^^Run^^** or **^^Retreat^^** ability this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of it to be the target. Then, draw a straight line between the closest points on the bases of this unit and the target. Each other unit (friendly and enemy) that the line passes across is a **collateral damage target**.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Inflict D3 mortal damage on each **collateral damage target**.

abilities.name: Big Name
abilities.timing: Deployment Phase
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the battle. You cannot pick an effect that has already been picked for another friendly **Tyrant**.

• ***Neck-wringer***: Enemy **^^Infantry^^** units that have a Health characteristic of 1 or 2 cannot contest objectives while they are in combat with this unit.
• ***Steed-eater***: Enemy **^^Cavalry^^** units cannot use **^^Retreat^^** abilities while they are in combat with this unit.
• ***Giant-wrestler***: Enemy **^^Monsters^^** cannot use **^^Rampage^^** abilities while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Brawlerguts
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a visible friendly non-**^^Hero Ogor Mawtribes Infantry^^** unit that has not used a **^^Fight^^** ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **^^Fight^^** ability immediately after the **^^Fight^^** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target's combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Firing from the Belly
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit has not used a **^^Move^^** ability this turn and was not set up this turn, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Powder Gnoblars
abilities.effect:
This unit's **Powder Gnoblars** are tokens. There are 2 **Powder Gnoblars** for every 4 models in this unit.
Each time this unit uses a **^^Shoot^^** ability, for each of this unit's **Powder Gnoblars** that are on the battlefield, you can re-roll 1 hit roll of 1 but if that attack misses, remove 1 of this unit's **Powder Gnoblars** from the battlefield after that **^^Shoot^^** ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Personal Enforcers
abilities.effect: While this unit is within the combat ranges of any friendly **^^Ogor Mawtribes Infantry Heroes^^**, both this unit and those **^^Heroes^^** have **^^Ward (5+)^^**.

abilities.name: Displays of Might
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.effect: This unit can use the 'Bull Charge' ability even if another friendly unit has used it this turn.

abilities.name: An Ogor's Ogor
abilities.effect: More than 1 effect of the 'Eat 'Em Alive' ability can apply to this unit at the same time; however, each effect can only be applied to this unit once.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Grutta's Horn and Hooves** is 5.

abilities.name: A Light Snack
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target's Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is automatically slain.

abilities.name: Been There, Ate That
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
• If any enemy non-**^^Monster^^** models were slain by this unit's combat attacks this turn, **Heal (D3)** this unit.
• If any damage points were allocated to an enemy **^^Monster^^** unit by this unit's combat attacks this turn and that enemy **^^Monster^^** has been destroyed, **Heal (D3+3)** this unit.

abilities.name: The Right Motivation
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^Ogor Mawtribes Infantry^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the turn, the following effects apply:
• While the target has not had any damage points allocated to it this phase, each time the unmodified hit roll for a combat attack that targets it is 1, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **^^Fight^^** ability has been resolved.
• If the target has had any damage points allocated to it this phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons.

abilities.name: Ogor-Made Ammunition
abilities.timing: Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the phase:
• All of this unit's shooting attacks must target that enemy unit.
• The Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Blastbelch** is D6+2 instead of D3+2.

abilities.name: Thunderous Diversion
abilities.timing: Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Ogor Mawtribes^^** unit that is in combat with an enemy unit that had any damage inflicted on it this turn by this unit's shooting attacks to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target can immediately use a **^^Retreat^^** ability as if it were your movement phase and can still use **^^Charge^^** abilities later in the turn. No mortal damage is inflicted on the target by that **^^Retreat^^** ability.

abilities.name: Oi! Pay Attention, Slobs!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit
abilities.effect: You must allocate D3 damage points to another visible friendly **^^Ogor Mawtribes^^** unit within 3" of this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). Then, that command has no effect and still counts as having been used, but the command points spent to use it are regained by your opponent.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Glutthorn's Horn and Hooves** is 5.

abilities.name: Pitiless Warlord
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **^^Charge^^** ability for an **^^Ogor Mawtribes^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
abilities.effect: Re-roll 1 dice in that charge roll.

abilities.name: Glutthorn Stampede
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is **^^Infantry^^**. On a 4+, the target has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Ravenous Counter-Attack
abilities.effect: Enemy units do not count as having charged while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Shock and Gore
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's attacks.

abilities.name: Torrent of Flame
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's **Fire Breath** if the target is **^^Infantry^^**.

abilities.name: Been There, Done That
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked to be the target of a non-**^^Core^^** ability
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.

abilities.name: Bloodthirsty Arrogance
abilities.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets a friendly **^^Meatfist Infantry^^** unit that did not charge in the same turn, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **^^Fight^^** ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Fleshy Stampede
abilities.effect: Add 2 to run rolls for friendly **^^Meatfist^^** units.

abilities.name: Meaty Charge
abilities.timing: Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Meatfist^^** unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Make a meaty charge roll by rolling a number of dice equal to the unmodified charge roll made this turn for the unit using this ability. Add 1 to the roll if the unit using this ability has more models than the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: The Unstoppable Feast
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Meatfist^^** unit that has not used a **^^Fight^^** ability this battle to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target can use **^^Charge^^** abilities even if it used a **^^Run^^** or **^^Retreat^^** ability earlier in the same turn.

abilities.name: Gluttonous Conquerors
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Control characteristic of friendly **^^Meatfist^^** units while they are in combat.

abilities.name: Greedy Chompers
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **^^Meatfist^^** units that are in combat to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, **Heal (X)** the target where X is equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Gruesome Devourers
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by a friendly **^^Meatfist^^** unit's combat attacks to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target cannot use **^^Retreat^^** abilities.

abilities.name: Snott, Gnoblar Thief
abilities.timing: Start of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy **^^Hero^^** that has any artefacts of power to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or lower than the current battle round number, the target no longer has any artefacts of power.

abilities.name: Trapper's Arsenal
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target has **^^Strike-Last^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Rusty Leadbelcher Gun
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Pick to load the gun with **Jagged Shrapnel** or **Lumpen Metal Scrap**, then apply the corresponding effect below:

***Jagged Shrapnel***: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If any models were slain by that mortal damage, halve the target's Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.

***Lumpen Metal Scrap***: Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Thick Blubber
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

abilities.name: Overpowering Mass
abilities.effect: When making meaty charge rolls for this unit, you can re-roll unmodified rolls of 1.

abilities.name: Force of Savage Personality
abilities.effect: Enemy units and enemy **^^Manifestations^^** cannot be set up within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Fill the Pot
abilities.effect: This unit's cauldron is either filled with grisly remains or empty. It starts the battle empty. If an enemy unit that was in combat with this unit this turn is destroyed and this unit's cauldron is empty, it becomes filled with grisly remains.

abilities.name: Great Cauldron
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit's cauldron is filled with grisly remains, pick a visible friendly **^^Mawseekers^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
This unit's cauldron is now empty. Pick 1 of the following effects:
***Bloodgruel:*** The target has **^^Ward (5+)^^** for the rest of the turn.
***Spinemarrow:*** Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Trogg-Guts
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^Ogor Mawtribes^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has **^^Ward (6+)^^** until the start of your next turn. If you picked a **^^Mawseekers^^** unit, it has **^^Ward (5+)^^** until the start of your next turn instead.

abilities.name: More Meat for the Pot...
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy unit this turn by this unit's combat attacks or by combat attacks made by a **^^Manifestation^^** summoned by this unit, and that enemy unit has been destroyed, add 1 to this unit's power level for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Wall of Meat
abilities.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for this unit if it has not charged this turn.

abilities.name: Troglodytic Lurkers
abilities.timing: Deployment Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit in reserve **lurking on the fringes**. It has now been deployed.

abilities.name: Frenzied Hunters
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it is **lurking on the fringes**.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare:
Pick this **Mawpit** to be a **sinkhole**. Then, you can pick another terrain feature within 12" of this **Mawpit** and that you have not already picked to be a **sinkhole** this battle to be a **sinkhole** for the rest of the turn.

Then, pick each enemy unit within 3" of the **sinkhole(s)** to be the targets.

From the second battle round onwards, increase the range at which another terrain feature can be picked to be a **sinkhole** by 3" for each previous battle round. If this terrain feature has a **Head Butcher**, increase the range at which another terrain feature can be picked to be a **sinkhole** by 6" for each previous battle round instead of 3".
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Feed the Maw
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: If this terrain feature does not have a **Head Butcher**, pick a friendly **Butcher** within 3" of it and not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Place the target on this terrain feature. The target is now a **Head Butcher** (see 'Hungry Sinkhole').

If this terrain feature is demolished, before removing it from the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the **Head Butcher**. Then, set up the **Head Butcher** on the battlefield wholly within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer a **Head Butcher**. If it is not possible to set up the **Head Butcher**, it is slain.

abilities.name: Step Away from the Maw
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: If this terrain feature has a **Head Butcher** that was not placed on it this turn, set up the **Head Butcher** on the battlefield wholly within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer a **Head Butcher**.

abilities.effect: Friendly **Gorger Mawpack** units can use **^^Charge^^** abilities even if they used a **^^Run^^** ability in the same turn unless they are wholly within 3" of a terrain feature.

abilities.name: Mawpits of Ghur
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.effect:
Roll 2D6 and add the number of **tasty morsels** you have to the roll. Apply the corresponding effect below for the rest of the battle round. Then, reset your **tasty morsels** to 0.
**2-3 – *Subdued:*** No effect.
**4-5 – *Peckish:*** Subtract 3 from the control scores of units that are **vulnerable to Mawpits**.
**6-8 – *Rumbling:*** Roll a dice for each unit that is **vulnerable to Mawpits**. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit.
**9-11 – *Famished:*** Units that are **vulnerable to Mawpits** cannot use commands.
**12+ – *Ravenous:*** Roll a D3 for each unit that is **vulnerable to Mawpits**. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: The Realm Hungers
abilities.effect: Units and **^^Manifestations^^** are **vulnerable to Mawpits** while they are on the battlefield unless they are wholly within 1" of a terrain feature that is not a **Mawpit**. This ability has no effect on **^^Roving Maw^^** units or units that have **^^Fly^^**.

abilities.name: Tasty Morsels
abilities.effect: Each time a model is slain by a friendly **Mawpit**'s 'Throat of Ghur' ability, you gain 1 **tasty morsel**.

abilities.name: Trampling Charge
abilities.timing: Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Roving Maw^^** unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Flasks of Congealed Maw-juices
abilities.effect: Friendly **Mawpits** within this unit's combat range have **^^Ward (5+)^^**.
